name: Dozzle
title: Snoozing Giant
description: Blocks the hallway and the build queue until snack time.
catchphrase: Rests a heavy snoozing snout peacefully across the spacebar.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Giant smoked marrow bone! Heavy hound eyelids droop happily! 🦴😴
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Enormous hound yawn that shakes his floppy ears, tail giving one thump! 😴
companionPersonality.petReaction: Resting heavy velvet snout across your keyboard spacebar in love! 😴💖

dialogue.idle: Stretched out like an enormous fuzzy rug on the floor. 😴
dialogue.working: Providing unshakeable, tranquil companionship through long tasks! 😴⚡
dialogue.thinking: Snout twitches in sleep... dreaming of chasing tennis balls... 🤔
dialogue.success: LAZY WAG! Tail thumps floor five times in celebration! 😴🎉
dialogue.error: Someone bumped his snout! Rolling over with gentle groan. 🐾
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... snoring deeply with floppy lips puffing out air... 🌙
